Recommended Gaming Resolutions:

  • 1600x900
  • 1920x1080
  • 2560x1440
The GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB was a performance-segment graphics card by NVIDIA, launched on July 19th, 2016. Built on the 16 nm process, and based on the GP106 graphics processor, in its GP106-400-A1 variant, the card supports DirectX 12. This ensures that all modern games will run on GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB. The GP106 graphics processor is an average sized chip with a die area of 200 mm² and 4.40 billion transistors. It features 1280 shading units, 80 texture mapping units, and 48 ROPs. NVIDIA has paired 6 GB GDDR5 memory with the GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB, which is connected using a 192-bit memory interface. The GPU is operating at a frequency of 1506 MHz, which can be boosted up to 1709 MHz, memory is running at 2002 MHz (8.0 Gbps effective).
Being a dual-slot card, the NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB draws power from 1x 6-pin power connector, with power draw rated at 120 W maximum. Display outputs include: 1x DVI, 1x HDMI 2.0, 3x DisplayPort 1.4a. GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB is connected to the rest of the system using a PCI-Express 3.0 x16 interface. The card a dual-slot cooling solution. Its price at launch was 299 US Dollars.
